dedupe_keys.name: thermaid fractured media heat and flow model

description: THERMAID is a MATLAB model published by the grvlbit project for flow and heat transport in fractured porous media. It uses an embedded discrete-fracture method and accounts for fracture mechanical stability, slip-related transmissivity changes and thermally induced stress. Users supply fracture geometry, grid and thermal/hydraulic settings; examples produce pressure and heat-transport fields. Coverage is global subsurface modelling with resolution and duration defined by the scenario. Example documentation identifies steady-state comparisons with COMSOL and an analytical pressure solution, alongside transient fracture-network cases. Public source and quick-start instructions are free under GPL-3.0, while MATLAB has separate access terms. A limitation is that the documentation remains under construction and persistent matrices must be cleared when changing grid or fracture-network resolution. The review did not reproduce the example comparisons or establish accuracy for a particular geothermal reservoir. THERMAID supports geothermal and subsurface-energy scenario simulation, complementing broader energy-system models such as PyPSA (model-pypsa). Its former gujans/THERMAID repository identity denotes the same code, not an additional resource.
